name: Tactile push button 6x6 mm
source: Typical datasheet/standard numbers for this part or its most common breakout; not yet measured
notes: Straddle the breadboard's centre gap in columns e and f, two rows apart (e.g. e20, f20, e22, f22). The legs facing each other across the gap (6.5 mm apart, pins 1a/1b and 2a/2b) are always connected; pressing joins the two rows. Wire the two rows on one side of the gap: one to the input pin (INPUT_PULLUP), the other to GND.
